article.story: DAVIDSON, N.C. -- — James Brown and Cedric Taylor III finished with double-doubles to lead Howard to a 64-58 victory over Davidson on Saturday night. Brown totaled 16 points and 13 rebounds for the Bison (3-2), while Taylor added 16 points, 10 rebounds, five assists, and three blocks. Drew Harris went 5 of 10 from the field to finish with 11 points. Nick Janowski led the way for the Wildcats (3-1) with 15 points and six rebounds. Eetu Heinonen added 13 points and Sam Brown scored 11 points. Howard went into halftime ahead of Davidson 36-30. James Brown put up 12 points in the half. Howard pulled off the victory after an 8-0 second-half run erased a one-point deficit and gave them the lead at 58-51 with 2:22 left in the half. Harris scored nine second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
